Izik Wolfe

ThreadSignals

📌

Hey everyone! I’m Izik, full-time Digital Project Manager (CTO) at a marketing agency and the creator of ThreadSignals. ThreadSignals started as a small tool I built for myself to find warm leads from real conversations. After receiving lots of interest from colleagues and strangers, I decided to make a full web-app of it.  
  
The truth is, we’re all tired of cold outreach (let's be honest...it sucks). I wanted something that shows you where people are already asking for help, recommendations, or solutions.  
  
This launch means a lot to me and to Chief (the other guy in my profile pic). I’d love your feedback, ideas, and support as we continue building ThreadSignals. Thank you for checking it out!
